dct_description_sm: OpenStreetMap exports for use in GIS applications. This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching: railway IN ('rail','station') Features may have these attributes: - [addr:full](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:full) - [addr:city](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:city) - [source](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:source) - [railway](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:railway) - [operator:type](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:operator:type) - [name](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name) - [ele](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:ele) - [layer](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:layer) This dataset is one of many [OpenStreetMap exports on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot). See the [Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team](http://hotosm.org/) website for more information.
